primary: Mean Recall@5 over documentation questions, ranked by distinct source sections.

intervals.method: Question-weighted nonparametric bootstrap; primary interval resamples source-section clusters with replacement. Also report paired question bootstrap. Percentiles 2.5/97.5, linear interpolation.

secondary: exact quoted-evidence coverage (quote fragments, not semantic correctness)

paired_comparisons.interpretation: An interval containing zero means no detectable difference, not equivalence.

default_rule: Use hybrid only if hybrid-minus-vector mean Recall@5 is positive and its paired section-cluster 95% lower bound is above zero. Otherwise use vector. This one prespecified method selection is not parameter tuning or an independent validation of the selected method.
configuration: Embedding, fusion, chunking and context algorithms freeze before scoring. No parameters, questions, facts or labels change after the run. Only the prespecified release default metadata can change according to the rule.
scope: Cosine threshold comes only from the expanded development set. Fake generation measures routing/refusal; it does not establish real-model injection resistance or answer correctness.
attempt: One exclusive run.json claim before model/database setup. Any subsequent failure consumes the attempt; preserve failed/partial output. No retry flag, overwrites or later retuning on these questions.
baseline: Frozen development-baseline.json binds the threshold and source corpus. CI continues to gate development only; no v1.1 holdout metrics run in CI.
labels: Synthetic, source-audited; not independently human-labelled. Source-section partition avoids original development primaries in the holdout, but shared facts can still occur through alternate supporting sections. No unseen-fact or real-operator-traffic claim.
context_metrics: Expanded-pack and exact quoted-evidence coverage describe selected candidates before refusal; also report generation calls and delivered section coverage for the selected method, counting unsent packs as zero. Quote coverage is an unweighted per-question fraction of declared exact source quotes, with its question/quote denominator; it is not semantic answer correctness.
launch: The held-out command requires the exact pushed freeze commit and a clean tracked working tree. All frozen input/implementation bytes are checked before the exclusive attempt.
baseline_after_selection: If the prespecified rule selects a different default, regenerate the development-only release baseline for that method. Keep the pre-run development-baseline.json inside this study unchanged.
